sectorDetailCards.title: Single Item Tracking
sectorDetailCards.spot: Gain full visibility in production with real-time product tracking by serial number.
sectorDetailCards.desc: In traceability processes, tracking each product with a unique number provides full visibility and control. This approach improves traceability for every item and creates a strong advantage in quality management and competitiveness.

sectorDetailCards.title: Batch / Lot Tracking
sectorDetailCards.spot: Achieve full control from production to delivery with batch / lot tracking.
sectorDetailCards.desc: In situations where product tracking is difficult, tracing each batch/lot ensures complete transparency and quality control throughout production. This makes it easy to follow where products are at every stage.

sectorDetailCards.title: P2L
sectorDetailCards.spot: Make your operations flexible and error-free by following the light with P2L solutions.
sectorDetailCards.desc: P2L solutions provide visual and/or audible guidance to operators in labor-intensive industrial manufacturing and assembly processes from production to logistics and from warehouse to delivery.

sectorDetailCards.title: RTLS
sectorDetailCards.spot: Track your equipment and employees instantly with RTLS and use resources at maximum efficiency.
sectorDetailCards.desc: With RTLS, you can easily monitor the real-time location of every equipment and employee in your facility. This technology helps use resources effectively, increases production efficiency, improves safety, and minimizes potential risks.

sectorDetailCards.title: Warehouse Management Systems
sectorDetailCards.spot: Optimize your operations and gain competitive advantage with warehouse management systems.
sectorDetailCards.desc: Warehouse Management Systems provide process control and management. By working with real-time data, they enable effective management of operations carried out across the organization.

sectorDetailCards.title: Integration
sectorDetailCards.spot: Ensure uninterrupted traceability in production with third-party system integrations.
sectorDetailCards.desc: Software integration enables different applications to exchange data and work in sync, eliminating difficulties from data entry to reporting for businesses using multiple systems. Integration can be provided with MES, ERP, WMS, CRM, industrial instruments, and third-party software.
